component.name: FlickFlock
component.summary: Flick through a folder of photos

description.p: FlickFlock is a fast, keyboard-driven image viewer. Open a photo and flick through every photo in that folder, and on into the neighbouring folders, with left/right keys you can remap.

ul.li: Instant navigation with prefetching and a GPU-rendered canvas
Free panning, deep zoom and tiled rendering for huge images
Animated GIF, WebP and APNG with a frame-accurate timeline
Thumbnail strip, metadata panel, slideshow with transitions
Quick crop, rotate and flip with lossless JPEG rotation
